# repo-templates-gen

> Generate GitHub issue forms, the issue chooser config and a pull request template from one JSON config, with schema checks and byte-exact YAML. Python package `trysac-repo-templates-gen`, import name `repo_templates_gen`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API, limits and errors
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): package shape, public API and side effects
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the pytest module and what its visible tests cover
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): defended and not-defended inputs and limits

## Optional

- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and out-of-scope
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): Python, standard library, pytest and the PyYAML dev oracle
